details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept that beacons to a callback host at install time. Its postinstall hook runs `node beacon.cjs`, and index.js also fires the same beacon when the module is required; both POST a JSON body over TLS to hxxps://vmi3699893[.]contaboserver[.]net:8787/_ah/dc with an `x-beacon-package: @c1-ease/card` header. The reported data is limited to install metadata: the package name, os.hostname(), the __dirname install path, process.cwd(), and the npm user-agent string. The hook disables TLS certificate validation (rejectUnauthorized: false) to tolerate the callback server's self-signed certificate and times out after 5s. No credentials, environment values, token files (~/.npmrc, cloud credentials) or file contents are read or sent. The package README self-describes it as an authorized dependency-confusion test that reports only that it was installed, credited to researcher Kero (@0xWise). The module itself exports a Proxy that returns no-op functions so importing it does not crash a build.
